\raggedright Grading instruction & \raggedright Ask for partial credit explicitly & It raised code agreement significantly after correction for DeepSeek-V4-Flash ($+0.062$ to $+0.070$ QWK) and GPT-5.1 ($+0.076$ to $+0.106$ QWK), lowered it significantly for no model, and moved the public short-answer datasets by less than the $\pm0.05$ margin, for a few extra input tokens \\[3pt]

\hline
\raggedright Conversation & \raggedright A clean conversation per answer & A shared, accumulating conversation lowered grades slightly (0.010 to 0.027 of the scale) and answer order moved individual grades by 0.08 to 0.10 of the scale \\[3pt]
